svg.title: Omnisnap Shows which elements render differently in every browser engine your users run, with one command and the browsers already installed. It compares element geometry instead of pixels, reports each difference at the element where it starts, and confirms the cause by re-measuring the page and checking a third engine. The prototype found 24/24 planted bugs, with no false reports across five engines. Status: design and prototype; v1 is specified in 17 module specs. License: Apache 2.0.
